decisions.reason: It is close to the firm's traditional handcrafted decorative range, was prominently shown in both observed years, and fits knowledge the firm can readily refine without strong formal R&D.
This pyramid stays very near the firm's core competences in wooden seasonal folk art and its continued home-page presence suggests a good fit with the established business.

Although it was presented as a flagship and remained prominent, the electronic music box is distant from the firm's established knowledge base and the firm shows no clear signs of in-house R&D that would support learning and improvement.
This accessory depends on the distant electronic music-box platform, and despite a second edition in 2019 it lies outside the firm's traditional absorptive base and is therefore harder to sustain.
The Christmas motif platform extends the same distant electronic concept, and without evident research capabilities the firm is likely to refocus resources on products closer to its craft strengths.
A themed Christmas pyramid clearly builds on the firm's established product knowledge, matches customer expectations, and should be easy to maintain and adapt within its existing craftsmanship base.
